description: A repository with no history — the drop-in folder before its first commit — still has a defined ledger and a defined head: the trailing build entry alone, whose prev is the 64-zero genesis. Without this rule the published agsc-ledger-head would be undefined for every freshly adopted Bundle.
reason: 2026-10-29: the case pins a trailing build entry whose actor names the builder, process:agsc/0.1.0; from 1.1 the actor is the fixed string process:agsc (AGSC-08-20a). Republished as ledger-0010.
